description: One scan or status event for one shipment at one hub at one event time. Contract for the Week 10 streaming simulation (file drops and live events). A future Kafka topic could carry the same payload.

message_key.reason: keeps all events of one shipment in order

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Stable physical-record key used for Candidate = Trusted + Quarantine reconciliation

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Streaming event identifier used for deduplication

fields.name: shipment_id
fields.description: Synthetic shipment business identifier; must exist in trusted shipments

fields.name: event_sequence_no
fields.description: Producer sequence within one shipment lifecycle; must be positive

fields.name: producer_time
fields.description: When the source system emitted the event; must not be earlier than event_time

fields.name: hub_id
fields.description: Hub where the event was recorded

fields.name: origin_hub_id
fields.description: Lane origin; must match the route

fields.name: destination_hub_id
fields.description: Lane destination; a DELIVERED event must be recorded here

handling.malformed_json: quarantine_scan_events under DQ-EVT-001 with the raw line kept
handling.undeclared_field: quarantine_scan_events under DQ-EVT-001 with the field name kept
handling.replayed_event_id: first arrival trusted; replay quarantined under DQ-EVT-001
handling.outside_watermark: quarantine_scan_events under DQ-EVT-001; inside-watermark late events stay trusted with is_late = true
